body.statement: For every observed law \(p\), the latent laws induced by \(\lambda\in\Xi(p)\) are exactly the members of \(\mathcal F(p)\). Thus \(\Xi(p)\) is nonempty whenever \(p=p(P_0)\) for some \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), and no compatible law satisfying any declared restriction is omitted from the endpoint optimizations.
body.justification: The endpoint programs must range over the full compatible-law fiber rather than a convenient latent subclass.
body.gap: Adjacent Job Corps bounds do not provide the response-type fiber equivalence needed for this noncompliance, exclusion, and covariate-directional selection specification.
body.consumer: The same-law endpoint constructions and exact local branch projection use \(\Xi(p)\) without changing the causal target.
